title: Choosing a Reliable Phone Plan
paragraphs: Tired of unexpected charges on his monthly bill, Karim spent an entire evening comparing several phone plans, trying to understand the fine print that most companies buried in their advertisements.
One plan looked attractively cheap at first glance, but Karim eventually noticed it charged extra fees for international calls, something he needed regularly to stay in touch with relatives abroad.

After narrowing his choices down to two reasonable options, he called customer service directly to ask specific questions rather than relying only on the marketing materials on each company's website.
The plan he finally chose cost slightly more monthly but included everything he actually needed, teaching Karim that the cheapest option upfront is not always the most affordable choice overall.
